# Qt Advanced Docking System

Easy SSH fetches [Qt Advanced Docking System](https://github.com/githubuser0xFFFF/Qt-Advanced-Docking-System)
via CMake `FetchContent` (see `EASY_SSH_ADS_GIT_TAG` in `cmake/EasySshVersions.cmake`).

The library is built and redistributed as a shared library under the
GNU Lesser General Public License v2.1. The full license text is bundled as
`LICENSES/LGPL-2.1-only.txt`.
